title: Monotonicity of guarded halting
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, let $\mathrm{oracle}$ be an oracle, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $G,G'$ be predicates on configurations. If a configuration $a$ halts with answer $r$ after some finite number $T$ of steps and satisfies $G$ at every time strictly before $T$, and every configuration satisfying $G$ also satisfies $G'$, then $a$ halts with the same answer $r$ while satisfying $G'$ at every time strictly before halting.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ halts with answer $r$ at some finite time $T$ and satisfies $G$ at every time $t<T$
